mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM sal_outstock WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 10 AND out_date >= #{from} AND out_date < #{to}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM pur_instock WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 10 AND instock_date >= #{from} AND instock_date < #{to}

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0)), 0), 2) FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_receivable WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_payable WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_material m LEFT JOIN inv_stock s ON s.material_id = m.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.qty, 0) < m.safety_stock
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(finish_qty), 0) FROM mrp_work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND finish_qty > 0 AND update_time >= #{from} AND update_time < #{to}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(out_date, '%Y-%m') AS `month`, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM sal_outstock WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 10 AND out_date >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(out_date, '%Y-%m')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(instock_date, '%Y-%m') AS `month`, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM pur_instock WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 10 AND instock_date >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(instock_date, '%Y-%m')

SELECT s.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, s.material_id AS materialId, m.code AS materialCode, m.name AS materialName, s.qty AS qty, ROUND(COALESCE(p.avg_price, m.ref_cost, 0), 4) AS price, ROUND(s.qty * COALESCE(p.avg_price, m.ref_cost, 0), 2) AS value FROM inv_stock s LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = s.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.material_id, SUM(d.qty * d.price) / NULLIF(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS avg_price FROM pur_instock_detail d JOIN pur_instock h ON h.id = d.instock_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 WHERE d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.material_id ) p ON p.material_id = s.material_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.qty > 0 ORDER BY s.warehouse_id, m.code

SELECT d.material_id AS materialId, m.code AS materialCode, m.name AS materialName, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to} GROUP BY d.material_id, m.code, m.name ORDER BY amount DESC, d.material_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.code AS dimCode, m.name AS dimName, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0)), 0), 2) AS costAmount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.amount - d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0)), 0), 2) AS profitAmount FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to} AND o.customer_id = #{customerId} GROUP BY d.material_id, m.code, m.name ORDER BY amount DESC, d.material_id

SELECT c.code AS dimCode, c.name AS dimName, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0)), 0), 2) AS costAmount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.amount - d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0)), 0), 2) AS profitAmount FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to} AND o.customer_id = #{customerId} GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.code, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC, o.customer_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.out_date, '%Y-%m') AS dimCode, DATE_FORMAT(o.out_date, '%Y-%m') AS dimName, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0)), 0), 2) AS costAmount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.amount - d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0)), 0), 2) AS profitAmount FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to} AND o.customer_id = #{customerId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.out_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY dimCode

SELECT m.code AS dimCode, m.name AS dimName, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount FROM pur_instock o JOIN pur_instock_detail d ON d.instock_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.instock_date >= #{from} AND o.instock_date < #{to} AND o.supplier_id = #{supplierId} GROUP BY d.material_id, m.code, m.name ORDER BY amount DESC, d.material_id

SELECT c.code AS dimCode, c.name AS dimName, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount FROM pur_instock o JOIN pur_instock_detail d ON d.instock_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_supplier c ON c.id = o.supplier_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.instock_date >= #{from} AND o.instock_date < #{to} AND o.supplier_id = #{supplierId} GROUP BY o.supplier_id, c.code, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC, o.supplier_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.instock_date, '%Y-%m') AS dimCode, DATE_FORMAT(o.instock_date, '%Y-%m') AS dimName, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount FROM pur_instock o JOIN pur_instock_detail d ON d.instock_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.instock_date >= #{from} AND o.instock_date < #{to} AND o.supplier_id = #{supplierId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.instock_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY dimCode

SELECT s.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, s.material_id AS materialId, m.code AS materialCode, m.name AS materialName, s.qty AS qty, ROUND(COALESCE(p.avg_price, m.ref_cost, 0), 4) AS price, ROUND(s.qty * COALESCE(p.avg_price, m.ref_cost, 0), 2) AS value, DATE_FORMAT(mv.last_in_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastInTime, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(mv.last_in_time)) AS ageDays FROM inv_stock s LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = s.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.material_id, SUM(d.qty * d.price) / NULLIF(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS avg_price FROM pur_instock_detail d JOIN pur_instock h ON h.id = d.instock_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 WHERE d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.material_id ) p ON p.material_id = s.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, warehouse_id, MAX(create_time) AS last_in_time FROM inv_movement WHERE deleted = 0 AND qty > 0 GROUP BY material_id, warehouse_id ) mv ON mv.material_id = s.material_id AND mv.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.qty > 0 ORDER BY m.code, s.warehouse_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_voucher WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'POSTED' AND voucher_date >= #{from} AND voucher_date < #{to}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN #{side} = 'DEBIT' THEN e.debit_amount ELSE e.credit_amount END), 0) FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id AND v.deleted = 0 AND v.status = 'POSTED' JOIN fin_subject s ON s.id = e.subject_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND s.code LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND v.voucher_date >= #{from} AND v.voucher_date < #{to}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outAmount FROM fin_account_flow WHERE deleted = 0 AND biz_date >= #{from} AND biz_date < #{to}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND finish_qty > 0 AND update_time >= #{from} AND update_time < #{to}

SELECT m.code AS dimCode, m.name AS dimName, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(d.actual_cost, d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0))), 0), 2) AS costAmount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.amount - COALESCE(d.actual_cost, d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0))), 0), 2) AS profitAmount FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to} GROUP BY d.material_id, m.code, m.name ORDER BY amount DESC, d.material_id

SELECT c.code AS dimCode, c.name AS dimName, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(d.actual_cost, d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0))), 0), 2) AS costAmount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.amount - COALESCE(d.actual_cost, d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0))), 0), 2) AS profitAmount FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to} GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.code, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC, o.customer_id

SELECT s.id AS supplierId, s.code AS supplierCode, s.name AS supplierName, COALESCE(a.order_count, 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(a.order_amount, 0) AS orderAmount, COALESCE(b.instock_amount, 0) AS instockAmount, b.receipt_line_count AS receiptLineCount, b.on_time_line_count AS onTimeLineCount, c.sample_qty AS sampleQty, c.qualified_qty AS qualifiedQty FROM base_supplier s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT po.supplier_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(po.total_amount), 0) AS order_amount FROM pur_order po WHERE po.deleted = 0 AND po.status IN (10, 20, 30) AND po.order_date >= #{from} AND po.order_date < #{to} GROUP BY po.supplier_id ) a ON a.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.supplier_id, COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount), 0) AS instock_amount, COUNT(*) AS receipt_line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.instock_date <= COALESCE(pod.delivery_date, po.order_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_line_count FROM pur_instock i JOIN pur_instock_detail d ON d.instock_id = i.id AND d.deleted = 0 JOIN pur_order po ON po.id = i.order_id AND po.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pur_order_detail pod ON pod.id = d.order_detail_id AND pod.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 10 AND i.instock_date >= #{from} AND i.instock_date < #{to} GROUP BY i.supplier_id ) b ON b.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.supplier_id, COALESCE(SUM(q.sample_qty), 0) AS sample_qty, COALESCE(SUM(q.qualified_qty), 0) AS qualified_qty FROM qc_inspect q WHERE q.deleted = 0 AND q.source_type = 'pur_instock' AND q.inspect_date >= #{from} AND q.inspect_date < #{to} GROUP BY q.supplier_id ) c ON c.supplier_id = s.id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND (a.order_count IS NOT NULL OR b.instock_amount IS NOT NULL OR c.sample_qty IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY instockAmount DESC, s.id

SELECT m.id AS materialId, m.code AS materialCode, m.name AS materialName, u.name AS unitName, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cf.period < #{period} THEN cf.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS beginQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cf.period < #{period} THEN cf.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS beginAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cf.period = #{period} AND cf.qty > 0 THEN cf.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cf.period = #{period} AND cf.qty > 0 THEN cf.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cf.period = #{period} AND cf.qty < 0 THEN -cf.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cf.period = #{period} AND cf.qty < 0 THEN -cf.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outAmount FROM cost_flow cf JOIN base_material m ON m.id = cf.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE cf.deleted = 0 AND cf.period <= #{period} GROUP BY m.id, m.code, m.name, u.name HAVING beginQty <> 0 OR inQty <> 0 OR outQty <> 0 ORDER BY m.code

SELECT s.material_id AS materialId, m.code AS materialCode, m.name AS materialName, u.name AS unitName, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS qty, ROUND(MIN(COALESCE(p.avg_price, m.ref_cost, 0)), 4) AS price, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.qty * COALESCE(p.avg_price, m.ref_cost, 0)), 0), 2) AS value, DATE_FORMAT(mv_in.last_in_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastInTime, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(mv_in.last_in_time)) AS ageDays, DATE_FORMAT(mv_out.last_out_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastOutTime, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(mv_out.last_out_time)) AS daysSinceOut FROM inv_stock s LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = s.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.material_id, SUM(d.qty * d.price) / NULLIF(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS avg_price FROM pur_instock_detail d JOIN pur_instock h ON h.id = d.instock_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 WHERE d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.material_id ) p ON p.material_id = s.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, MAX(create_time) AS last_in_time FROM inv_movement WHERE deleted = 0 AND qty > 0 GROUP BY material_id ) mv_in ON mv_in.material_id = s.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, MAX(create_time) AS last_out_time FROM inv_movement WHERE deleted = 0 AND qty < 0 GROUP BY material_id ) mv_out ON mv_out.material_id = s.material_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.qty > 0 AND (mv_out.last_out_time IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(mv_out.last_out_time)) >= #{days}) GROUP BY s.material_id, m.code, m.name, u.name, mv_in.last_in_time, mv_out.last_out_time HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) > 0 ORDER BY value DESC, m.code

SELECT wo.id AS orderId, wo.order_no AS orderNo, m.code AS materialCode, m.name AS materialName, wo.qty AS planQty, wo.finish_qty AS finishQty, wo.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(wo.plan_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS planStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(wo.plan_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS planEndDate, CASE WHEN wo.status NOT IN ('FINISHED', 'CLOSED') AND wo.plan_end_date IS NOT NULL AND wo.plan_end_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue FROM mrp_work_order wo LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = wo.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE wo.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(wo.plan_start_date, DATE(wo.create_time)) >= #{from} AND COALESCE(wo.plan_start_date, DATE(wo.create_time)) < #{to} ORDER BY overdue DESC, wo.order_no

SELECT op.code AS dimCode, op.name AS dimName, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.employee) AS employeeCount, COALESCE(SUM(wr.good_qty), 0) AS goodQty, COALESCE(SUM(wr.bad_qty), 0) AS badQty, COALESCE(SUM(wr.work_minutes), 0) AS workMinutes FROM mrp_work_report wr LEFT JOIN mrp_operation op ON op.id = wr.operation_id AND op.deleted = 0 WHERE wr.deleted = 0 AND wr.report_time >= #{from} AND wr.report_time < #{to} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_wo_step ws WHERE ws.id = wr.wo_step_id AND ws.deleted = 0 AND ws.work_center_id = #{workCenterId}) GROUP BY wr.operation_id, op.code, op.name ORDER BY workMinutes DESC, wr.operation_id

SELECT wr.employee AS dimCode, wr.employee AS dimName, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.operation_id) AS operationCount, COALESCE(SUM(wr.good_qty), 0) AS goodQty, COALESCE(SUM(wr.bad_qty), 0) AS badQty, COALESCE(SUM(wr.work_minutes), 0) AS workMinutes FROM mrp_work_report wr WHERE wr.deleted = 0 AND wr.report_time >= #{from} AND wr.report_time < #{to} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_wo_step ws WHERE ws.id = wr.wo_step_id AND ws.deleted = 0 AND ws.work_center_id = #{workCenterId}) GROUP BY wr.employee ORDER BY workMinutes DESC, wr.employee

SELECT mi.work_order_id AS workOrderId, wo.order_no AS orderNo, iit.material_id AS materialId, m.code AS materialCode, m.name AS materialName, COALESCE(SUM(iit.should_qty), 0) AS shouldQty, COALESCE(SUM(iit.actual_qty), 0) AS actualQty FROM mrp_material_issue mi JOIN mrp_material_issue_item iit ON iit.issue_id = mi.id AND iit.deleted = 0 JOIN mrp_work_order wo ON wo.id = mi.work_order_id AND wo.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = iit.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE mi.deleted = 0 AND mi.status = 'AUDITED' AND mi.create_time >= #{from} AND mi.create_time < #{to} GROUP BY mi.work_order_id, wo.order_no, iit.material_id, m.code, m.name HAVING COALESCE(SUM(iit.should_qty), 0) > 0 ORDER BY wo.order_no, m.code

SELECT COALESCE(u.dept_id, 0) AS deptId, COALESCE(d.name, '未分配部门') AS deptName, s.code AS subjectCode, s.name AS subjectName, COALESCE(SUM(e.debit_amount), 0) AS amount FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id AND v.deleted = 0 AND v.status = 'POSTED' JOIN fin_subject s ON s.id = e.subject_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.create_by AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND s.direction = 'DEBIT' AND s.category IN ('COST', 'PROFIT_LOSS') AND v.voucher_date >= #{from} AND v.voucher_date < #{to} GROUP BY u.dept_id, d.name, s.code, s.name ORDER BY deptName, amount DESC, s.code

SELECT e.id AS employeeId, e.emp_no AS empNo, e.name AS employeeName, d.process_name AS processName, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.work_order_id) AS woCount FROM hr_piece_wage w JOIN hr_piece_wage_detail d ON d.period_id = w.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.period = #{period} GROUP BY e.id, e.emp_no, e.name, d.process_name ORDER BY e.emp_no, d.process_name
